_comment: The graphs inside smart-base's `L4` named subgraph, declared FROM WITHIN on the pattern of `../L1/graph.json` (owner, 2026-11-13: 'L1..L3 as named subgraphs', 'Organize tools, skills, processes the same way', and an L4 subgraph for the point-of-care and application work). Each entry is `subgraph: true`, a directory of the LAYER listed by `resolveDirectories` with `within: "smart-base-L4"`. Paths are relative to THIS directory. Declare only what exists: L4 has no schemas/, because the knowledge graph has no L4 layer.
name: L4

directories.description: The L4 skills: the point-of-care work a DAK's roles carry (reviewing a client's history and the decision-support guidance, completing an SDC questionnaire and extracting it, applying decision support and activating accepted guidance, informing the client, recording a rationale), and briefing, building and running an L4 application. Package `smart-l4`.
The executable L4 processes: questionnaire data capture and acting on decision support.
The L4 tools: the immunization schedule app, run locally.
